|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の秘密工作ドロイドに対抗するべく設計された。ドロイド置き場を頻繁に往来し、潜伏中のスパイの正体を暴く。左のお尻には“メーカーに感謝”の文字が刻まれている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' R-3PO (Ar-Threepio).

'''Card text:'''
Once each turn during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each opponent’s spy at the same place. That loss is 2 if the spy is a droid or undercover, or 4 if both.

'''Lore:'''
Designed to counter Imperial espionage droids. It often visits the droid pool and uncovers undercover spies. “Thank the Maker” is engraved on its left buttocks.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 通訳用ドロイド.
